proposals.rationale: Correct spec, buggy code. FR-021 requires accurate min/max/mean latency telemetry and SC-006 requires accurate TelemetrySnapshot values. Confirmed at HEAD 2fc1cd3c: the three sync paths (src/actor.rs:332,397,637) and the blocking wait_for_cqe completion site (:718) correctly capture a submission Instant and record start.elapsed(), but the primary async-completion path harvest_completions() still calls record_op(0, op.bytes) with a hardcoded 0 even though InflightOp carries a populated `start: Instant` (:101, set at :480/:554). Async ReadAsync/WriteAsync ops record 0 ns latency, driving min_latency_ns to 0 and skewing the mean. Code violates a correct, agreed requirement, so per policy this is an ALIGN task (no source edited). Single task covers both FR-021 and SC-006 (same root cause).
